title: Prescribed digit sums in residue classes and a conjecture of Murthy (OEIS A077754)
description: Machine-checked resolution of Amarnath Murthy's conjecture (OEIS A077754, 2002): a positive integer n admits a multiple with at least two digits, all nonzero, and digit sum n, iff n is not in {1,2,5,11} and not a multiple of 10. Both implications are kernel-verified in Lean 4 (v4.35.0, mathlib) with axiom base {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}; the paper also proves a general equidistribution band theorem on fixed-length digit fibres (paper-side result), and formalizes the OEIS sequence values on displayed anchors.
